evidence.source: Main paper, Experimental/Computational details, evidence ev_doc_066b6a58a933_000309_47b089fba6b3: harmonic frequencies confirmed optimized minima and TD-DFT produced UV-Vis spectra.

Main paper p. 4123 (PDF page 8), evidence ev_doc_066b6a58a933_000239_4c461d29046b and Fig. 12: seven L1–IBU isomers; leading DMSO isomer has both carboxylate oxygens hydrogen bonded to the two NH groups.
Main paper p. 4123 (PDF page 8), evidence ev_doc_066b6a58a933_000240_2a8c542e90c3: aromatic stacking occurs in the complexes, particularly the more stable species.

Main paper p. 4123 (PDF page 8) layout block 9 and evidence ev_doc_066b6a58a933_000241_b5f5c4e72ba0: binding energy from the most stable L1, IBU-, and complex conformers is -42.5 kJ mol-1 in DMSO (minus sign verified in PDF layout).
Main paper Fig. 13 discussion, evidence ev_doc_066b6a58a933_000250_98997b3b5cb3: complex formation gives a reasonable red shift of the lowest-energy absorption band without net NH deprotonation.
